# Scaling fixtures

`blocks-2000x1600.png`: a synthetic 2000x1600 PNG (colour blocks, dark grid lines, a white diagonal band), generated by a script, not a
capture of anything. It is over Jev's 1568 px side limit, so `SkiaImageScaler` shrinks it to 1568x1254. `Scaled_bytes_match_the_pinned_sha256`
pins the sha256 of the scaled PNG so a SkiaSharp bump that changes the picture fails a test instead of silently changing what Jev sees.
